purpose: Separate formula sensitivity from successful transfer by putting completed galaxy, reconstructed-cluster, raw-lensing, topology, and Solar-null experiments on a within-experiment normalized scale.

normalization.rule: raw_span divided by the largest raw_span within the same stage, domain, observable, and metric
normalization.reason: Arcseconds, Jensen-Shannon divergence, km/s, and image-root counts are not commensurate.
normalization.family_priority: median normalized leverage times log2(1 + independent stages), with a 25 percent breadth bonus for each additional observed domain
normalization.claim_limit: Priority ranks sensitivity and recurrence, not physical correctness or statistical evidence.

required: At least one coordinate family is measured in both galaxy and cluster domains.
The next formula must use no object-specific gravity parameter.
The next test must report raw image-root stability separately from RMS.
A Solar null or screen must be evaluated even when it is exact by construction.
